title: Fairness for Unobserved Characteristics: Insights from Technological Impacts on Queer Communities
findings: Religion is identified as an unobserved characteristic, similar to sexual orientation, that poses significant challenges for algorithmic fairness. The paper highlights that religious minorities face risks from AI systems related to persecution, surveillance, censorship, and online abuse. It suggests that fairness techniques developed for queer communities, which do not rely on observed sensitive attributes, could also be beneficial for protecting religious groups.
